  • When you cause a creature to become @Compendium[undertaking-homebrew.conditions.ZOBZ8V2YME5YOYZR]{Lionized}, the bonus die increases to 1d6 until they are no longer @Compendium[undertaking-homebrew.conditions.ZOBZ8V2YME5YOYZR]{Lionized}.
  • When you cause a creature to become @Compendium[undertaking-homebrew.conditions.WHN3T2G6R8HUKOQX]{Villainized}, the damage die increases to 1d10 until they are no longer @Compendium[undertaking-homebrew.conditions.WHN3T2G6R8HUKOQX]{Villainized}.
  • You gain 1 @Compendium[undertaking-homebrew.abilities.ZVH8L715PTWTQLSE]{Immersion} when you roll Initiative.
